data.title: Speeding fine: €143.50, 21 km/h over the limit
data.summary: The district's fines authority (Bußgeldbehörde) issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) dated 17 February 2027 for driving 21 km/h over the 50 km/h limit in a built-up area on 26 January 2027. You must pay €143.50 and get 1 point in the driving-fitness register. You can object within two weeks of delivery.
data.explanation: You are accused of speeding on 26 January 2027. The fine is €115.00, plus €25.00 fees and €3.50 delivery costs, so €143.50 in total, plus 1 point. If you accept it, pay after the decision becomes final (Rechtskraft). The total is due two weeks after that. If you dispute the accusation or the penalty, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record with the fines authority. The app shows the deadline. A court is not bound by this amount and may decide to your disadvantage. Consider legal advice before objecting. The delivery stamp on the envelope is only partly legible, so check the date.

items.title: File objection (Einspruch) against fine
items.action: If you dispute the accusation or the penalty, file an objection in writing or on record with the fines authority.
items.consequence: Without an objection in time, the fine notice becomes final and the fine must be paid. A court may decide to your disadvantage after an objection.
items.quote: Die Frist für den Einspruch beträgt zwei Wochen ab Zustellung; einzulegen ist er schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Landkreis Beispielmünde – Bußgeldbehörde.

items.title: Pay fine and fees
items.action: Pay €143.50 to the fines authority's account two weeks after the notice becomes final, unless you object.
items.quote: Fälligkeit des Gesamtbetrags: zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft.
